component.name: TortoiseHg
component.summary: Graphical tools for the Mercurial distributed revision control system

description.p: TortoiseHg is a set of graphical applications for the Mercurial distributed revision control system.

It provides a visual repository explorer, commit tools, visual diff and merge interfaces, and various other utilities to make working with Mercurial repositories intuitive and efficient. It can be used as a standalone application (TortoiseHg Workbench) or integrated directly into your file manager.
